what: Carry the member's app choices (rest timer, plate setup, reminder days, tips seen) in the MettleUp account copy, not only in the backup file
why: A member who signs in on a new phone gets workouts back but must set every choice again; the backup file already knows which choices to carry
impact_why: Hits every member who changes phones, the exact moment the account is sold for
my_view: My view: do it; one more item kind reusing the backup file's own list of choices. It also closes the pounds-and-kilos finding (FN-B-switch-phone-onboarding-db-a-01) in the same step.

what: On a new phone after Bring back my workouts, say plainly that progress photos stayed on the old phone and how to move them (Download my data on the old phone, Restore on the new one)
why: The account copy keeps only the photo's date, not the picture, so photos come back as records with nothing to show and no word why
impact_why: Progress photos are the most personal thing a member keeps; a blank photo after a phone change feels like data loss
my_view: My view: do the words now. Do not start copying the pictures to our server: it breaks the privacy promise and the free storage (see FN-L8-phone-cloud-backup-ai-01).

what: Offer a one-time 'Move my old Google Drive backup into my MettleUp account' for members who still have a Drive backup, then retire the Drive code
why: Drive restore is the last Drive path left, planned to go around Feb 2027; members who never move lose that old history quietly
impact_why: Every member who backed up to Drive before the account existed
my_view: My view: do it before the Drive removal date; restore from Drive while signed in already sends the copy, so this is mostly one card and one button. Ties to FN-B-time-phone-components-2-02.

what: In the Delete my account check, add a 'Download my data first' button before the final Delete
why: Today the delete pop-up goes straight to deleting the server copy; a member who later loses the phone has nothing
impact_why: Few members delete, but the ones who do and regret it lose everything
my_view: My view: do it; one extra button on a screen we already have, the usual pattern in account-deletion flows.

what: If the coach comes back, drop 'bring your own Claude, OpenAI or Groq key' from the member app and run the coach through our own server with a set monthly cap
why: Indian gym members do not have AI company keys; asking for one means almost nobody would use the coach. Hevy's and Fitbod's AI features (as known by Jun 2026, not re-checked live) never ask for a key
impact_why: Decides whether the coach has any users at all if it is switched back on
my_view: My view: do not switch the coach back on as it is. Keep it off until there is a server path with a cost cap; the key screens can then be removed.

what: Reuse the offline coach's typed logging ('bench 60 kg 3x10', Hindi and Hinglish too) as a quick 'type your workout' box on the Workout tab, without the whole coach
why: The offline coach already understands typed workouts and body weight with no internet and no key, but it is switched off with the coach, so members cannot use it
impact_why: Fast logging for members who hate tapping through sets; Hinglish support is something the big apps do not offer
my_view: My view: worth a small trial with one gym; the hard part (the reader) is built. Needs its own UAT on wrong readings before release.

what: Drop meal-photo calorie logging from the coach plans
why: It needs an AI key, the offline coach can only ask the member to describe the meal, and food logging is not what MettleUp is judged on (gyms paid, members still training on day 30)
impact_why: Keeps the coach small if it ever returns
my_view: My view: remove it from scope; it adds cost and wrong-calorie risk for no gym benefit.

what: Keep the MettleUp Plus limits on what is extra (more own exercises, very old charts) but never on getting your data out: Download my data, Restore and Bring back my workouts stay free for ever
why: Hevy's free plan (as known by Jun 2026, not re-checked live) also caps own exercises and chart history, and members accept that; locking a member's own history behind pay would feel like hostage-taking and hurt reviews
impact_why: Sets the line for every future paid feature in this area
my_view: My view: write this down as a rule now, before Plus limits are switched on. Also see FN-L19-phone-cloud-backup-ai-03 (restore gets around the 7-exercise limit).

what: After Bring back my workouts, say what came back in full: workouts, routines, body weight and measurements, not only the workout count
why: The done line counts workouts only, so a member who mainly logs body weight reads 'Everything was already on this phone' and worries
impact_why: Seen once per new phone, but it is the moment trust is won or lost
my_view: My view: do it with the wrong-count fix (FN-B-truth-phone-cloud-backup-ai-a-03); same line, same test.
